items.summary: A powerful 7.7 magnitude earthquake struck off Panama's southern coast Friday, shaking the country's capital as officials investigated a potential tsunami threat. The U.S. Geological Survey initially measured the earthquake at magnitude 8.0 before lowering its estimate to 7.7. The quake struck at 1:56 p.m. ET, at a depth of 7.8 miles, near Pitaloza Arriba, Panama. A 5.5 magnitude aftershock followed, with its epicenter approximately 50 miles east of the initial earthquake. The Panama Canal said operations were continuing normally following Friday's earthquake, with emergency protocols activated and technical teams inspecting facilities for possible damage. Canal officials said their priority was ensuring the safety of workers, vessels, crews and nearby communities as assessments continued.

"We speak often about standards and discipline. Standards are what we expect, and my standards are clear: be accountable for your actions; do the right thing, especially when no one is looking; and always be guided by our core values that govern our conduct at every rank," he wrote. "We live, work, and socialize alongside the people of Okinawa; their home is our home. Every interaction with our neighbors either builds or undermines the trust that is essential to our team. When that trust is damaged, it affects the strength of our alliance and the security of this region. Accordingly, we will take time to think hard about discipline, standards and our alliance responsibilities," Watson added. items.summary: این مطلب توضیح می‌دهد که چرا بی‌بی‌سی فارسی در یکی از پرتنش‌ترین دوره‌های تاریخ معاصر ایران بر اصول بنیادین روزنامه‌نگاری، از جمله بی‌طرفی، راستی‌آزمایی، استقلال تحریریه و پاسخ‌گویی، پافشاری می‌کند. در این مقاله، با مرور شیوه تصمیم‌گیری‌های تحریریه، فرآیند راستی‌آزمایی اخبار، نحوه انتخاب مهمانان و برخورد با خطاها و انتقادها، تشریح می‌شود که هدف بی‌بی‌سی نه جانبداری از هیچ طرف، بلکه ارائه گزارشی دقیق، مستقل و مبتنی بر شواهد است تا مخاطبان بتوانند بر اساس اطلاعات قابل اعتماد، خود درباره رویدادها قضاوت کنند.
